description: Implementation of RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter class for splitting text recursively by separators, used in RAG ingestion.

classes.name: RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter
classes.description: Class that splits text recursively into chunks based on separators, with configurable chunk size and overlap.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the text splitter with chunk size, overlap, and separators.

methods.name: split_text
methods.description: Public method to split text into chunks.

methods.name: _split_text
methods.description: Recursively splits text using specified separators, respecting maximum recursion depth.

methods.name: _merge_splits
methods.description: Merges split strings into chunks respecting chunk size and overlap.

methods.name: _force_split
methods.description: Forcefully splits text into chunks of chunk size when no separators are applicable.
